programme.title: Fudbal - Španska liga: Osasuna - Athletic Bilbao 07.11.
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Basket 3x3 - World Tour: Zaisan, grupna faza
programme.desc: Fiba World Tour 3 na 3 za razliku od World Cupa uključuje momčadi iz pojedinih gradova dok na World Cup pravo natjecanja imaju nacionalni timovi. Kao vrhunac 3 na 3 košarke World Tour natjecanje pod okriljem Fibe od 2012. godine mami uzdahe ljubitelja ovog dinamičnog sporta. Temeljna razlika između klasične dvoranske košarke je broj igrača na terenu, a to je po tri u svakoj momčadi. Bitne razlike su još, da se igra na polovici standardnog košarkaškog terena na jedan koš. Utakmica traje deset minuta ili ukoliko jedna momčad prva dođe do 21 poena meč se automatski prekida.

programme.title: Košarka - Turska liga: Tofas - Trabzonspor
programme.desc: Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Rukomet - Njemačka liga: Berlin - Kiel
programme.desc: Rukometna Bundesliga je najviši rang rukometnih takmičenja u Njemačkoj. Uz špansku ligu, Bundesliga se smatra najboljom evropskom ligom. Osnovana je 1965. godine kao odvojeno takmičenje sjeverne i južne regije. Tek od 1977. deluje kao jedinstveno takmičenje. Trenutno broji 19 ekipa u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Najviše osvojenih titula broji rukometni klub Kil. Visok kvalitet rukometne igre i ispunjene tribine razlog su zašto je Bundesliga toliko praćena u cijelom svijetu.

programme.title: Football - Spanish league: Atlético Madrid - FC Barcelona 08.11.
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. programme.title: Basket 3x3 - World Tour: Zaisan, četvrtfinala
programme.desc: Fiba World Tour 3 na 3 za razliku od World Cupa uključuje momčadi iz pojedinih gradova dok na World Cup pravo natjecanja imaju nacionalni timovi. Kao vrhunac 3 na 3 košarke World Tour natjecanje pod okriljem Fibe od 2012. godine mami uzdahe ljubitelja ovog dinamičnog sporta. Temeljna razlika između klasične dvoranske košarke je broj igrača na terenu, a to je po tri u svakoj momčadi. Bitne razlike su još, da se igra na polovici standardnog košarkaškog terena na jedan koš. Utakmica traje deset minuta ili ukoliko jedna momčad prva dođe do 21 poena meč se automatski prekida.

programme.title: Košarka - Grčka liga: Panathinaikos - Kolossos
programme.desc: Grčka A1 pod nadzorom HEBE (Grčki košarkaški savez) smatra se jednom od najjačih liga sveta nakon neprikosnovene američke NBA lige. Liga se sastoji od 14 timova i igra se u periodu od oktobra do juna u kojem svaki tim odigra 26 utakmica za vreme regularnog dela. Nakon što su sve ekipe odigrale međusobno po dva susreta na domaćem i gostujućem terenu po osam timova igra plejof u kojemu se dobija prvak. Prvo službeno takmičenje se održalo u sezoni 1927-1928, dok se plejof pojavio tek 1986-1987. godine. Uz mega popularne ekipe Panatinajkos i Olimpijakos tu se nalaze još i timovi kao što su Aris i AEK koji su ostavili trag u evropskoj košarci.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: The Monkey King and his gang are confronted by the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her two sexy sisters, plus a cast of fanciful characters.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: As the roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collected proofs of corruption from the officials, they demanded to become the governor of the country.

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Word gets out that blind Ku has the secret of the Buddha's Palm and he is besieged by everything from terrifying giant birds to gangs of martial arts warriors.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Roving swordsman Tu Meng-Fei chances to rescue a female pupil Mu Wan-Erh and later, another girl Li Sai-Nan from underworld leader Leng Tien-Lei. Li wants to take vengeance on Leng who murdered her parents.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: Chou Lian Huan is good at fist fighting in Shanghai. In order to please a hostess named Chen Ju Fang, he is willing to sacrifice everything and fight against the son of the gang leader in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Cave Of Silken Web
programme.desc: The 3rd part of Shaw Bros' Journey To The West sees sex and spectacle combine as our heroes are trapped by the seductive 7 Spiders, hellbent on achieving immortality by eating monks!

programme.title: Beyond The Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng plays a man who is supposed to die at the hand of a sword with a teardrop forged onto the blade.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: The story evolves around Lin Shao-teh, a poor student who was engaged to Chien-king, the daughter of billionaire Wang Chun.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber Of Shaolin
programme.desc: An award-winning film in 1978. Liu Yu-Te escapes to Shaolin Temple, mastered the skill of 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers. Succeeded his revenge and introduced the 36th Chamber.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: A gang of unemployed martial artists seem to have their bad fortunes.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond.

programme.title: The Duel Of The Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: Set in the Han Dynasty, a gang of loyalists led by Yang Chi-ching and Lin Dai, strive to drive a wedge between the governor and his son, eventually turning them against each other.

programme.title: Rape Of The Sword
programme.desc: Li Li-hua as a swordswoman out to reclaim her murdered husband's 'Green Sword', the sharpest blade in the world.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-Killer
programme.desc: A wealthy womanizer writes a diary about his romantic escapades, but the women with whom he’s been intimate have all been murdered.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Several years before GHOSTBUSTERS was a massive Hollywood hit, Wong Jing scripted this hilarious supernatural action comedy starring Alexander Fu and directed by Lau Ka Wing.

programme.title: To Kill A Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan.

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: A schizophrenic who refuses to believe her pilot lover was killed and believes his death to be a lie created to end their relationship.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. The union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu (Ya Feng) head to HK, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: An unparalleled kung-fu masterpiece from the one and only Chang Cheh. The dying Poison Clan master sends his last pupil on a dangerous mission to hunt down the five titular warriors.

programme.title: Call Of The Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: It's tale of brave knights, chivalry and fair maidens where the Swift Knight finds himself involved in romance, court intrigue and deadly jousts while trying to protect a baby who is the Emperor's secret heir apparent.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful young fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealousy and a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Cheng-ying and his sister ingratiate themselves into the life of the diabolical Lin Hao, as they plot to avenge their father's death, with a little help from the lethal titular move.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Action maestro Chang Cheh tells the story of Chin Feng, who meets the beautiful Ting Hung while on the run for accidentally killing an arrogant bully.

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: Chang Cheh directs an early incarnation of Ti Lung's lone swordsman in this kung-fu classic. King Eagle crosses blades with the Tongs after falling for Li Ching's beautiful Chief.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu depicts the glamourous world of nightclub performers in this story about two struggling sisters, played by Irene Chen Yi Ling and Betty Ting Pei.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei stars as a young singer, Hsiao-Yun, struggles between her success in career and her relationship with her pianist lover Li Yen-nan.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand.

programme.title: Carry On Doctors And Nurses
programme.desc: Director Chan Friend created this delightful variation on the British 'Carry On!' film series. It can certainly make you laugh with all the comical acts happened in the Hospital!

programme.title: The Knight Of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take it back.

programme.title: Village Of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky.

programme.title: The Stormriders (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: An evil warlord takes in 2 students (Wind And Cloud) in an effort to become invincible so he can take over the world.

programme.title: Love In A Fallen City
programme.desc: A cynical playboy pursues an introverted divorcee in the decadence of Hong Kong on the eve of the 1941 Japanese invasion.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: In 1990s China, a northern cop joins forces with a local detective in the southern city of Binhai to track down a ruthless gang responsible for a string of violent robberies. A battle of wits ensues between law enforcement and criminals.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: An action-thriller centered on a vampire-like woman who eats the skins and hearts of her lovers.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father is exposed.

programme.title: Mid-Night Two
programme.desc: The film tells the story of a group of people in order to search for treasure, traveled thousands of miles to the ancient legend of the ghost mountain, for thousands of years whoever have entered the ghost mountain all disappeared, it is said that the mountain buried a female body never decomposed, the Yin fire didn't extinguished in thousand of years, every 2:30 in the morning the Yin fire is the heaviest, all the ghosts would return.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: A young man arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: Anita Yuan Yung-yi stars as an illegitimate daughter who inadvertently finds a pearl with a genie in it. Michael Wong is the genie who gives her three wishes, leading to a lot of hilarity and even a little heartbreak.

programme.title: Iceman: The Time Traveller
programme.desc: The imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later pass and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: My Darling Genie

programme.title: Fist Of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Son Donglu, a newly promoted detective teams up with Guo Zhui, fastest gunman in Tiancheng and Xiaowu, a novice policeman to investigate the mystery deaths in a bullet factory.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Furious Attack (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: A former special forces soldier infiltrates northern Myanmar to rescue his missing daughter, fighting against scam gangs and organ traffickers in a final showdown with the crime boss.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: A greedy Hong Kong businessman hires a young hunter to capture a giant gorilla said to live deep in the Indian jungle. The hunter finds the ape, and living with it he finds a feral human female who has befriended the creature.

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: When Qing Cheng was a teenager, he was attacked by an unknown mutant monster and lost his family and memory. He was regarded by the villagers as an ominous person who would bring disaster.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

programme.title: Flying Swords Of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, innkeeper Jade has disappeared and a new inn has risen from the ashes - one that's staffed by marauders masquerading as law-abiding citizens, who hope to unearth the fabled lost city buried in the desert.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: A priest discovers that the water supply in his village has been contaminated by bats, and while in the process of digging a well to find new water supply, he inadvertently unearths the corpse of an evil Western priest.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs and Octopus accept a job from their landlord: kidnap a baby. Soon, the baby awakens strong paternal feelings in the two crooks, leading to complications when it comes to handing him over to his possibly crazy gang boss grandfather.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Three lotharios vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School, an extremely non-monastic institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: A former special forces soldier infiltrates northern Myanmar to rescue his missing daughter, fighting against scam gangs and organ traffickers in a final showdown with the crime boss.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: The Flying Mr. B

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: An imperial agent gets ridiculed for his various inventions, until his supportive wife encourages him to attend a conference, which's actually a trap to kill all the doctors serving the emperor, where his crazy inventions come in handy.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the un human form as Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and made to stay human.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon 2 (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Ho San is now the boss of the casino and seems to hold infinite power, but various foes are stacked against him, and his personal relationships continue to cause problems.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow leaves for the big city to try and save his home by winning the huge snooker tournament.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: 10 year-old Marbles witness the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl. But Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: A woman is raped and murdered during World War 2. Forty years later she returns to haunt her persecutors from the Tao Tao Mansion. A professor and his family move into the house, only to have the spirits take their son.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire
programme.desc: The planned reburial of a town elder goes awry as the corpse resurrects into a hopping, bloodthirsty vampire, targeting everyone responsible for digging the grave. A Taoist Priest and his two disciples attempt to stop the terror.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: The film revolves around a woman in her late twenties who rediscovers her talent for boxing after a long hiatus. She unexpectedly meets her former boxing coach and the pair work together to help her reach the final rounds of professional boxing matches.

programme.title: The Sorcerer And The White Snake
programme.desc: A master monk tries to protect a naive young physician from a thousand-year-old snake demon. A contest of psychic powers results in mayhem.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: A washed-up writer forms an unlikely friendship with a teenager from Long Island.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: Wong Fei-Hung is a mischievous, yet righteous young man, but after a series of incidents, his frustrated father has him disciplined by a master of drunken martial arts.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: As a man leaves his wife and daughter, a series of brief conversations, observed gestures, chance encounters and impulsive acts, tell the story of the relationships that flounder and thrive in the wake of this decision.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: A rich playboy gets blown up by a gangster when he flirts with the gangster's wife. Through a series of circumstances, his professor makes him a synthetic body that allows him to change into anything he wants.

programme.title: Soaring Seagulls : PL Stories
programme.desc: 'Soaring Seagulls' tells the incredible story of Brighton & Hove Albion; from the brink of collapse and years in the lower leagues to becoming one of the Premier League's smartest and most admired clubs. Featuring interviews with the key figures behind Brighton's rise, alongside celebrity fans who followed every twist along the way, this documentary charts a remarkable journey of survival, ambition and one of the greatest comebacks in modern football.

programme.title: 2017/2018 (Mci) : Review Of The Season
programme.desc: A review of all the best goals, action and drama from Premier League seasons past.

programme.title: Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink : PL Moments
programme.desc: Over a nine season spell in the Premier League, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink etched his name into footballing folklore as one of the most dynamic goalscorers in the competition's history. Fourth all time in Premier League goals for Chelsea, Hasselbaink's iconic freekicks and powerful finishes have seen him score some of the League's most memorable goals. This week, the Dutch international sits down with PL Moments to break down how to strike the ball, and talk us through his ten favourite moments from his Premier League career.

programme.title: Romeo Lavia : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Romeo Lavia's performances at the heart of Chelsea's midfield this season suggest he is on the way to fulfilling the immense promise that persuaded Pep Guardiola to sign him for Manchester City, having spotted him at an under-15 youth tournament in Belgium. Lavia then impressed at Southampton but injuries and the burden of expectation have stalled his progress at Chelsea. The Belgian opens up on the challenges he has overcome so far and his hunger to make up for lost time under Xabi Alonso.

programme.title: Tue 10 Nov : Match Officials Mic'D Up
programme.desc: Pro Ref Chief Refereeing Officer Howard Webb joins Michael Owen to provide context and explanation behind refereeing decisions, using match footage and previously unreleased audio between the on-field officials and VAR teams.

programme.title: Theo Walcott: My Premier League Years : Rewind
programme.desc: At just 16 years old, Theo Walcott attracted the attention of Arsene Wenger, who brought the electric youngster to Arsenal. The Englishman bagged over 100 goals for the Gunners, becoming one of their most prolific Premier League stars. He recalls the key moments and matches from 12 years in north London.

programme.title: Owen Hargreaves: Man Utd 07/08 : Rewind
programme.desc: 2007/08 saw Manchester United crowned both Premier League and European champions. Owen Hargreaves played a pivotal role in that success, in his debut season at Old Trafford. He recalls the drama and glory of an unforgettable campaign.

programme.title: Mw10: Mun V Avl : Match Highlights 26/27
programme.desc: Each Premier League game from the 2026/27 season condensed into an individual 26-minute highlights show.

programme.title: Ashley Young : PL Moments
programme.desc: After more than two decades at the top, Ashley Young looks back on an incredible Premier League career. From breaking through at Watford and starring for Aston Villa to becoming a champion with Manchester United and playing on until the age of 40, Ashley counts down the 10 moments that defined his time at the very top of English football.

programme.title: Alan Shearer : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Alan Shearer reflects on a childhood where his eye for goal came naturally, and led to a career that ended with him setting a Premier League goalscoring record that remains unchallenged. The former Southampton, Blackburn and Newcastle man explains what makes a great striker, and reveals a piece of advice that he's passed on to a Premier League star of today

programme.title: Ep12 : The Catch-Up Show

programme.title: Marcus Stewart - The Fight Of My Life : PL Stories
programme.desc: Ipswich Town legend and former Sunderland striker Marcus Stewart built a career on taking on some of football's toughest challenges. Now, he faces a very different battle; one that has changed his life beyond the pitch and revealed a strength and determination far greater than anything football demanded of him.

programme.title: Mikel Arteta : PL Stories
programme.desc: We explore Mikel Arteta's impact at Arsenal and the managerial approach behind his success, reflecting on how his upbringing and football education in the Basque region shaped his thinking. We examine his tactics, how he develops players and the standards he sets throughout the club. We look at the key decisions that have turned Arsenal into Premier League champions.

programme.title: Tue 10 Nov : Match Officials Mic'D Up
programme.desc: Pro Ref Chief Refereeing Officer Howard Webb joins Michael Owen to provide context and explanation behind refereeing decisions, using match footage and previously unreleased audio between the on-field officials and VAR teams.

programme.title: Michael Owen: My Breakthrough Years : Rewind
programme.desc: Michael Owen burst onto the scene for Liverpool at just seventeen years of age, and in two consecutive seasons the teenage sensation won the Premier League Golden Boot. Owen recalls those campaigns for the Reds, reliving the key moments that helped him develop into one of the greatest players of his generation.

programme.title: 2017/2018 (Gb: Salah) : Goals Of The Season
programme.desc: We take a look back at some of the most spectacular and important goals from previous Premier League seasons.

programme.title: (Subbed) Pep - The Legacy : PL Stories
programme.desc: As Manchester City embark on a new chapter, we celebrate the extraordinary legacy of Pep Guardiola, the visionary who transformed not only a football club, but the Premier League itself. From his formative years as a player and coach to redefining excellence in English football, we trace the journey that made him one of the greatest managers the game has ever seen. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man who changed the standards by which every Premier League manager is measured.

programme.title: (Subbed) Roberto Mancini : PL Stories
programme.desc: From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli. Mancini's interview is brutally honest, highlighting the defining moments and extraordinary career of one of football's most compelling characters.

programme.title: Kai Havertz : The Big Interview
programme.desc: As a young boy cheering from the terraces of his hometown club, Alemannia Aachen, Kai Havertz fell in love with a striker by the name of Erik Meijer. In this Extended version of the first Masterclass of the new season, Havertz' footballing icon surprises him at training, before the two share tricks of the trade on the art of forward play, recreating some of the Arsenal striker's best goals.

programme.title: Patrick Vieira : The Big Interview
programme.desc: From street football in Senegal to becoming Arsenal captain, Patrick Vieira reflects on the journey that shaped one of the league's most iconic figures, as he tells Steve Bower about the proudest chapter of his career: the 2003-04 Invincibles season.

programme.title: Peter & Kasper Schmeichel : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Sharing 6 Premier League trophies between them, Peter and Kasper Schmeichel can be classed individually amongst the best goalkeepers of the Premier League era. This week, the Big Interview takes the rare opportunity of having father and son together. The pair discuss their fascinating dynamic, a relationship that developed from Kasper's formative years growing up around a father who won 5 Premier League titles in a dominant Manchester United side. The pair then share incredible insight around the evolution of the art of goalkeeping, spanning their own careers to the present day.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.desc: Sinetron Cinta Seluas Samudra bercerita tentang pernikahan palsu yang terpaksa dijalani Andrian dengan asisten rumah tangganya, Maya, demi menyelamatkan nama baik keluarga pasca-kaburnya sang pengantin asli, perlahan menumbuhkan cinta tulus yang diuji oleh intrik balas dendam. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 18.25 WIB.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: Bundesliga Special Show
programme.desc: E7Podsumowanie najważniejszych informacji dotyczących jednej z najlepszych lig piłkarskich na świecie - niemieckiej Bundesligi.

programme.title: AJ Auxerre - Małe miasto, wielki klub
programme.desc: Opowieść o AJ Auxerre. Klub został założony w 1905 roku w niewielkim mieście w Burgundii. Mimo lokalizacji z dala od metropolii przez lata rzucał wyzwanie tuzom francuskiego futbolu. Największy sukces odniósł w 1996 roku, gdy został mistrzem Ligue 1.

programme.title: Moi bohaterowie
programme.desc: Joshua KimmichJoshua Kimmich to jeden z najzdolniejszych defensywnych piłkarzy młodego pokolenia w Niemczech. Jest filarem Bayernu Monachium i reprezentacji Niemiec. To jeden z tych zawodników, do których należy piłkarska przyszłość.

programme.title: Legendy Bundesligi
programme.desc: Biografie postaci, które trwale zapisały się w historii niemieckiej Bundesligi. W programie m.in. wywiady z zasłużonymi piłkarzami oraz klubowymi działaczami. Widzowie zapoznają się także z wypowiedziami ekspertów piłkarskich.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Venezia FC - Udinese Calcio
programme.desc: Trener Kosta Runjaić zapłacił posadą za słabe wyniki Udinese. Jego następcą został Javier Zanetti, który zadebiutuje w roli szkoleniowca Zebr w meczu przeciwko Venezii. Arancioneroverdi są jednymi z ich bezpośrednich rywali w walce o utrzymanie.

programme.title: Najlepsi napastnicy Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Stefan Kuntz, Mario Basler, Fredi Bobic, Ulf Kirsten, Toni Polster i wielu innych zachwycało kibiców swoimi umiejętnościami na boiskach Bundesligi w latach 90. ubiegłego stulecia. W programie przyjrzymy się sylwetkom łowców bramek i oczywiście najpiękniejszym golom w ich bogatych kolekcjach.

programme.title: HHH - Hamburger SV
programme.desc: Widzowie zobaczą historię jednego z najważniejszych zespołów niemieckiej piłki. Hamburger SV sześć razy zdobywał tytuł mistrza Niemiec. Aktualnie drużyna gra w 2. Bundeslidze i stara się wrócić do elity niemieckiej piłki klubowej.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole Borussii Dortmund
programme.desc: Michael Zorc, Stéphane Chapuisat, Robert Lewandowski, Andreas Moller to tylko niektórzy spośród piłkarzy Borussii Dortmund, którzy potrafili zdobywać bramki w zadziwiający sposób. W programie widzowie zobaczą najładniejsze gole w wykonaniu zawodników BVB.

programme.title: Birds of paradise
programme.desc: Filmowcy i dziennikarze zebrali w jednym miejscu ciekawostki dotyczące Bundesligi. Każdy znajdzie w tym filmie coś dla siebie, niemiecka liga bowiem to nie tylko sport, ale ogromne przedsięwzięcie dotykające różnych dziedzin życia takich jak ekonomia, socjologia moda i wiele innych.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole Schalke 04
programme.desc: Barwy klubu FC Schalke 04 Gelsenkirchhen reprezentowało wielu klasowych snajperów, m.in. Klaus Fischer, Klaas-Jan Huntelaar, Ebbe Sand, Kevin Kuranyi. W programie widzowie zobaczą najlepsze gole w historii drużyny z Gelsenkirchen.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: SC Freiburg - 1. FC Union Berlin
programme.desc: Freiburg imponuje formą. Po ośmiu kolejkach znajduje się na trzeciej lokacie i traci zaledwie 2 punkty do liderującego Bayernu Monachium. Przeskoczyć aktualnego mistrza Niemiec chce starciem z Unionem. Zespół z Berlina po fatalnym początku sezonu zaczął wstawać z kolan i w ostatnich meczach zdobył 6 oczek, tym samym przybliżając się do opuszczenia strefy spadkowej.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: SSC Napoli - SS Lazio
programme.desc: Azzurri stracili sporo punktów w bieżącym sezonie Serie A, w efekcie ligowa czołówka im uciekła. Przed nimi mecz z będącym na fali zespołem Biancocelestich, który po dziewięciu kolejkach był liderem tabeli.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Estrela Amadora - SL Benfica
programme.desc: SL Benfica przegrała w tym sezonie ligowym tylko z FC Porto i przed 11. kolejką traci do niego pięć punktów. Jeśli Orły chcą pozostać w walce o mistrzostwo, nie mogą sobie pozwolić na kolejną stratę punktów. O komplet oczek powalczą na wyjeździe z Estrelą Amadora, która ma za sobą gorszy okres - przegrała cztery ligowe mecze z rzędu.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: 1. FSV Mainz 05 - FC Bayern Monachium
programme.desc: W poprzedniej ligowej kampanii Mainz potrafiło postawić Bawarczykom trudne warunki. Die Roten wywieźli co prawda z Mewa Areny cenne zwycięstwo, lecz Zero-Piątki strzeliły im aż trzy gole (4:3). Trzymamy kciuki, by w 9. kolejce sezonu 2026/27 obie ekipy stworzyły równie ciekawe widowisko.

W rozgrywkach 2003/2004 trenerem zespołu z Bremy był Thomas Schaaf. Zielono-białe barwy reprezentowali wówczas m.in. Angelos Charisteas,Christian Schulz i Frank Baumann.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Estrela Amadora - SL Benfica
programme.desc: SL Benfica przegrała w tym sezonie ligowym tylko z FC Porto i przed 11. kolejką traci do niego pięć punktów. Jeśli Orły chcą pozostać w walce o mistrzostwo, nie mogą sobie pozwolić na kolejną stratę punktów. O komplet oczek powalczą na wyjeździe z Estrelą Amadora, która ma za sobą gorszy okres - przegrała cztery ligowe mecze z rzędu.

programme.desc: Trener Kosta Runjaić zapłacił posadą za słabe wyniki Udinese. Jego następcą został Javier Zanetti, który zadebiutuje w roli szkoleniowca Zebr w meczu przeciwko Venezii. Arancioneroverdi są jednymi z ich bezpośrednich rywali w walce o utrzymanie.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Vitoria SC - FC Porto
programme.desc: FC Porto nadal może pochwalić się kompletem zwycięstw w lidze. Ma ich już na koncie 10, a w poprzednim meczu pokonało Estoril 4:0. O przedłużenie tej imponującej serii podopieczni Francesco Farioliego powalczą w 11. kolejce na wyjeździe z Vitorią SC.

programme.title: Moi bohaterowie
programme.desc: Joshua KimmichJoshua Kimmich to jeden z najzdolniejszych defensywnych piłkarzy młodego pokolenia w Niemczech. Jest filarem Bayernu Monachium i reprezentacji Niemiec. To jeden z tych zawodników, do których należy piłkarska przyszłość.

programme.title: Legendy ligi niemieckiej
programme.desc: Rudi VoellerBiografie postaci, które trwale zapisały się w historii niemieckiej Bundesligi. W programie m.in. wywiady z zasłużonymi piłkarzami oraz klubowymi działaczami. Widzowie zapoznają się także z wypowiedziami ekspertów piłkarskich.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Cagliari Calcio - Frosinone Calcio
programme.desc: Frosinone jest jedną z niespodzianek pierwszej części sezonu. Obecnie znajduje się na szóstej lokacie i traci zaledwie 3 punkty do miejsc pozwalających na grę w Lidze Mistrzów. Przybliżyć się do nich chce starciem z notującym spadek formy Cagliari. Zespół z Sardynii przegrał 4 ostatnie mecze ligowe i spadł na dwunastą pozycję.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Toulouse FC - RC Strasbourg
programme.desc: Strasbourg w poprzedniej kolejce ograł Auxerre 5:1 i tym samym wydostał się ze strefy spadkowej. Teraz chce rozpocząć pogoń za ligową czołówką, do której traci 5 punktów. Przybliżyć się do niej spróbuje pojedynkiem z Toulouse. Gospodarze zanotowali spadek formy, zdobywając tylko oczko w ostatnich dwóch seriach gier, nie trafiając przy tym do bramki rywala.

programme.title: Podróż do świata Calcio

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: AC Monza - Atalanta BC
programme.desc: Atalanta od początku sezonu miała bić się o miejsca pozwalające na grę w Lidze Mistrzów. Jednak zamiast pierwszej czwórki bliżej jest strefy spadkowej, nad którą ma 4 oczka przewagi. Odskoczyć od niej i zmniejszyć stratę do czołówki spróbuje starciem z Monzą. Beniaminek zdobył w tej kampanii zaledwie 7 punktów i jest jednym z kandydatów do opuszczenia Serie A.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: Hamburger SV - Borussia Mönchengladbach
programme.desc: Podopieczni Merlina Polzina są w słabej dyspozycji - przegrali dwa mecze z rzędu. W poprzedniej kolejce ulegli na wyjeździe Eintrachtowi Frankfurt 1:3. W kolejnym spotkaniu Hamburger SV zmierzy się u siebie z ostatnią w tabeli Borussią Mönchengladbach. Gospodarze nie mogą jednak zlekceważyć przyjezdnych, zwłaszcza że ci punktowali w dwóch poprzednich meczach. Najpierw wygrali 3:2 z VfB Stuttgart, a następnie bezbramkowo zremisowali z SC Paderborn 07.

programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa
programme.desc: Jürgen Klopp poprowadził Borussię Dortmund do mistrzostwa Bundesligi w sezonie 2010/2011. Było to pierwsze znaczące trofeum w karierze niemieckiego trenera. O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole VfL Wolfsburg
programme.desc: Edin Dżeko, Grafite, a także Andrzej Juskowiak to tylko trzech wybitnych napastników, którzy zdobywali gole w barwach Wolfsburga. W szeregach tej drużyny występowało bowiem wielu klasowych snajperów. W programie zobaczymy najładniejsze bramki zdobyte przez piłkarzy Wilków.

programme.title: Basketball - NBA league: Philadelphia - Toronto
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA League, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide on the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers.

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: Maccabi Tel Aviv - Hapoel Tel Aviv
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.title: Košarka - VTB liga: Samara - CSKA
programme.desc: The VTB League brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia also participate in the league. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, other clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, of which the best placed becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013.

programme.title: They love Serbia
programme.desc: The number of players and coaches who found their happiness in Serbia is not small. They belong to different sports, and here they could see for themselves how true the stories about the famous Serbian hospitality are. Some of them found the love of their life here, found godfathers, friends for life, got citizenship. What is their attitude towards Serbia and what is their life like, find out in our show.

programme.title: Košarka - ABA liga: Zadar - Partizan
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. Along with the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the highly technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: Panathinaikos - Barcelona
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.desc: Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.
